researcher_notes: Fresh independent opus re-extraction (redo pass). 11 SAFELOG datasheet PDFs, all identical 4-page layout: p.1 cover, p.2 prose + dimensioned drawing + DEVICE INFORMATION block, p.3 TECHNICAL DATA table (PERFORMANCE / ELECTRICAL DATA / SAFETY DEVICE / OPERATION DATA), p.4 photos + peripherals + company footer. SAFELOG structures its range as 5 chassis families (M4, L2, X1, S3, GT1, XS1) with per-chassis functional variants ('core' = no load handling, 'lift' = scissor/central lift, 'tow' = lifting-bolt trailer coupling, 'spin' = lift with independently rotating turntable). The DB currently holds only 6 family-level rows; the datasheets document 11 distinct variants -> variant completion applied, one product entry per printed 'Product name'. Variants of one family share the chassis (identical length/turning radius/battery/speed) and differ only in the load-handling module and topload rating. IMPORTANT CROSS-CUTTING FLAG: the DB carries infrastructure_free=true and navigation_type='Natural Feature (SLAM)' for every SAFELOG row; the datasheets list the STANDARD localization stack as 'Magnetic track, RFID, LiDAR (LLS), odometry, inductive sensor' (M4/L2/X1/S3) resp. 'Odometry, grid codes' (GT1/XS1) - i.e. predominantly infrastructure-bound. The datasheets never state 'infrastructure-free', so I left the field null rather than flagging a hard conflict, but the existing DB value is not datasheet-supported and should be re-verified. Also: 'LiDAR (LLS)' is not disambiguated in any of the 11 documents (LLS could be reflector-based laser localization OR natural-contour SLAM) - I deliberately did NOT map it to an AP0 navigation_type value. SCOPE BUG OBSERVED IN DB (not introduced by me): product 'SAFELOG AGV X1' (product_type Mobile AMR) carries values in lifting_height (80) and stacking_capability (0), both of which exist only in scope Logistics:AGV:Forklift; and all six SAFELOG rows carry vna_capable=0, also Forklift-only scope. The AMR-scope equivalent of lifting_height is lift_height.

company_wide_context.notes: Footer on p.4 of every datasheet: 'SAFELOG GmbH | Henleinstrasse 4 | 85570 Markt Schwaben | Germany'. CE taken from the p.3 'Conformity' row (CE, FCC). conflicts.detail: DB row 'SAFELOG AGV M4' (Tugger AGV) carries max_payload=200 kg. No SAFELOG M4 datasheet prints 200 kg anywhere: M4 core = 300 kg topload, M4 lift = 1,000 kg topload, M4 tow = 1,500 kg. Source: SAFELOG_Datasheet_M4-core_EN.pdf p.3, SAFELOG_Datasheet_M4-lift_EN.pdf p.3, SAFELOG_Datasheet_M4-tow_EN.pdf p.3. Not resolvable from the datasheets - flagged for manual resolution.

Values agree, but the row LABEL is ambiguous: SAFELOG_Datasheet_M4-tow_EN.pdf p.3 prints the 1,500 kg figure under 'Topload level (kg)', whereas the equivalent S3 tow sheet (SAFELOG_Datasheet_S3-tow_EN.pdf p.3) prints its figure under 'Towload level (kg)'. Read together with the M4 tow's footnote 4 ('load of 1,000 kg, 80% driving share') this looks like a datasheet labelling slip on SAFELOG's side. Recorded as towing_capacity (matching the existing DB value), max_payload left null.

conflicts.detail: INTERNAL datasheet inconsistency, not a DB conflict. SAFELOG_Datasheet_S3-core_EN.pdf p.3 footnote block prints 'Turning radius (m): 0.8' while p.2 prose states the robot 'can rotate on the spot in a space less than 90cm' (= 900 mm swing DIAMETER, i.e. ~450 mm radius). The same contradiction appears in SAFELOG_Datasheet_S3-tow_EN.pdf (p.2 'require a diameter of less than 90 cm to do so' vs p.3 'Turning radius (m): 0.8'). SAFELOG's 'Turning radius' row is most likely a swing-circle diameter. I recorded the explicitly labelled 'radius' figure (800 mm) per the safe-mapping rule, but this needs a ruling before import - the two readings differ by ~2x on a KO field.

products.notes: max_gradient=0 is a REAL stated value, not a null placeholder: p.4 explicitly states the GT1 cannot drive on inclines and ramps, while the p.3 table leaves the row blank ('—'). Worth a reviewer check that a 0 here does not get treated as 'unknown' downstream. ingress_protection_rating is printed under 'Conformity (planned)' - the IP54 rating is announced, not yet certified; recorded but flagged. grid_required left null: standard localization is 'Odometry, grid codes' (p.3), i.e. floor codes are used for LOCALIZATION, which is not the same as the AP0 'fixed storage grid' concept (AutoStore-style) - I did not conflate the two. Also note: the DB row already carries grid_required=0. infrastructure_free left NULL although the STANDARD localization ('Odometry, grid codes', p.3) requires permanent floor codes: the optional LiDAR (LLS) configuration might be infrastructure-free and the document does not say. The existing DB value infrastructure_free=true is therefore unsupported by this datasheet but not directly contradicted - flagged in the coverage report rather than raised as a conflict.
